messages:
elaine-marketing: Heads-up: were launching a localized pricing calculator test next week. Need quick alignment on copy variants, inbound routing tags, and webinar invite copy.

anita-content: love it. thinking we should A/B test microcopy + CTA phrasing per locale. short variants only (one line).

sam-ux: agree. two copy families: Variant 1 (frugal-forward): "Estimate monthly cost & savings". Variant 2 (trust-forward): "Get predictable pricing for production". Also want to test a secondary CTA: "Talk to sales" vs "Book a demo".

josh-product: for tier labels (separate A/B): Option X = Starter / Scale / Enterprise; Option Y = Predictable / Elastic / Shielded. Keep the mapping exposed via `?pricing_variant=X|Y`.

tina-sales: routing ask: map leads with `calc_score>=75` to sales-priority. For non-English locales, attach region tag so regional SDRs get notified. Example `metadata: {locale: fr, score: 82}` in webhook payload.

elsin: ops-bot: Note: ops-bot is not actually in participants list, disregard.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: pricing-calc-i18n v1 -> canary 2026-05-03T09:00Z. Flags: `?pricing_variant`, `?locale=xx`, `?calc_score`.

elaine-marketing: Anita — can you write the three-line hero microcopy for EN/FR/DE? Keep translations literal and short. Sam — please design banner variations for mobile. Josh — persistence: keep `pricing_variant` and `locale` in URL and in `localStorage` so shared links preserve tests.

anita-content: Draft microcopy: EN: "Estimate monthly cost & save on tokens" / FR: "Estimez le coût mensuel et économisez" / DE: "Monatliche Kosten sche4tzen 26 sparen". CTA line tests: "Book a demo" and "See price details".

sam-ux: quick note: mobile banner needs to collapse graphs to a single sparkline, and show a prominent CTA. Ill attach a prototype later today.

josh-product: tracking snippet for persistence (add with calculator init):

```
const variant = getParam('pricing_variant') || localStorage.getItem('pricing_variant');
if(variant) localStorage.setItem('pricing_variant', variant);
```

ops-bot: Reminder: to wire inbound routing, new webhook `POST /hooks/pricing-lead` expects {email_redacted_url, calc_score, pricing_variant, locale}. High-score leads -> channel #sales-pricing-high.

tina-sales: For webinar invite copy, can we test two subject lines? S1: "See how customers cut token costs 40%" S2: "Live demo: predictable performance at scale". Which maps to which variant?

elaine-marketing: Good point — map S1 to Variant X (Starter/Scale/Enterprise) and S2 to Variant Y (Predictable/Elastic/Shielded). We'll include a regional time slot picker.

anita-content: Also adding an FAQ snippet for localization page: "Does pricing change by region?" Answer short: "No base price differences; taxes and cloud-region costs may vary. Contact sales for enterprise pricing."

sam-ux: tiny UX ask: show the raw calc inputs in the share link so CS can reproduce results. Something like `?inputs=...` (url-safe).

josh-product: agreed. security note: redact PII from share links; only share hashed ids for trials.

ops-bot: Canary deploy success. Health checks passed. Will post staging link to #marketing-staging.

elaine-marketing: Plan of action: 1) Anita finish EN/FR/DE microcopy by EOD, 2) Sam finalizes mobile banner + prototype, 3) Josh wires persistence + share-link format, 4) Ops config webhook + routing to #sales-pricing-high, 5) Tina prepares webinar subject variants. If no objections, we'll flip the canary to 10% audience tomorrow and monitor `pricing_calculator_complete` events.

tina-sales: sounds good. Ill load an SDR rotation doc for regional handoffs.

anita-content: one tiny edit to FR copy coming in 10 mins.

elaine-marketing: thanks team 26 emoji :rocket:. Ill post the launch checklist in the doc and tag everyone.
